info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Careers Applications Submit-v1-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Submission API enables users to submit job applications directly through the platform. It serves as a crucial interface for job seekers to manage their application process, allowing them to provide necessary documentation and personal details. This API typically caters to both applicants looking to join a company and recruiters aiming to streamline the application intake. By integrating this API, organizations can enhance their hiring workflows, improve candidate experience, and efficiently collect applicant information.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a new application for processing. Ensure that all required fields are filled accurately before submission to avoid any errors.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit an application. It must contain all the necessary details as specified in the schema to successfully process the application request.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the processed application data.

requestId.description: A unique identifier for the request.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the request.

customer.description: Details of the customer making the request.

priority.description: The priority level of the request, where higher numbers indicate higher priority.

amount.description: The monetary amount associated with the request.

currency.description: The currency code for the amount.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates whether a notification is required upon request completion.

requestedAt.description: The date and time when the request was made.

channel.description: The channel through which the request was made.

recordIndex.description: The index of the record related to the request.

CreateCareersApplicationsSubmitRequest.description: Request body for submitting an application.

firstName.description: The first name of the customer.

lastName.description: The last name of the customer.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

vipCustomer.description: Indicates whether the customer is a VIP.

customerAge.description: The age of the customer in years.

CreateCareersApplicationsSubmitResponse_.title: Application Submission Response

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the application submission.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number assigned to the application submission.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the submission.

state.description: Current state of the application after submission.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the application submission in milliseconds.

message.description: Detailed message related to the submission outcome.

CreateCareersApplicationsSubmitResponse_.description: Response schema for the application submission operation. It contains the status of the submission, reference number, result ID, current state, processing time, and message details.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created the submission.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the submission was created in ISO 8601 format.

automated.description: Indicates whether the submission was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains details about the creation of the application submission, including who created it and when.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This header provides insight into the performance of the operation.
